company.name: Revolve Surgical
company.shortDescription: Revolve Surgical develops surgical robotics for use in operating rooms.
company.description: Revolve is building the world’s only surgical robot designed for every operating room. Its simple yet powerful design makes it the only robot that can service the over 1 million abdominal surgeries performed outside of hospitals in the US. The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario.

aiResearchSummary.text: Revolve Surgical is developing a tip for a surgical instrument featuring a movable, pitchable cradle and a pivoting member to improve gripping and manipulation in robotic systems, as described in Tip for a surgical instrument and related methods. They also work on robotically assisted fulcrum effect correction devices and methods and on control interfaces for medical devices that separate position and end effector orientation. Together these efforts advance robotic instrument tips, motion control and interface design.
